attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA should urgently work in cooperation with like-minded organizations to establish a broad front committed to the defeat of the ultra-right.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The foundation of a broad front should rest on improved cooperation and coordination among democratic left organizations on issues such as the defense of democracy, socialist and solidarity economics, the Green New Deal, labor organizing, reproductive choice, universal health care, racial justice, and progressive taxation.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes democratic socialism has democracy at its core.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes democratic socialism requires a foundation in the principles of liberty and equality.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes democracy requires protection from the influence of concentrated economic power.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes in the democratization of the economy in service of the public good and the general welfare.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes in the democratization of society and in an end to all forms of bigotry, discrimination and oppression.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes the United States must adopt a democratic socialist foreign policy in world affairs.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"DSA is opposed to militarism and imperialism.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
